apps.label: Sussex Experiment APK
apps.description: Bundled Sussex Experiment Quest runtime. It matches the approved Sussex study shell build, publishes quest_twin_state, accepts quest_twin_commands, and exposes the public runtime-config surface tracked by the Windows app.

apps.label: Peripersonal Unity Runtime APK
apps.description: Bundled peripersonal-space single Unity runtime APK. It launches with particles invisible, accepts runtime condition and visibility commands, publishes participant-scoped LSL state, participates in the continuous global recording workflow, and emits low-cadence foreground/input-owner beacons for the WPF operator shell.
